shortDescription: With this Dual Zone wine chiller, you’ll keep red and white wines at their optimal temperatures so you’re always ready to host company. Its capacity is large enough to hold 46 bottles, and with a LED light wall that illuminates the entire interior, you can find the one you want in no time.
metaDescription: With this Dual Zone wine chiller, you’ll keep red and white wines at their optimal temperatures so you’re always ready to host company. Its capacity is large enough to hold 46 bottles, and with a LED light wall that illuminates the entire interior, you can find the one you want in no time. Magnum bottle storage is especially helpful, letting you chill up to six 1.5 liter bottles without sacrificing space on other shelves. Offering the latest in connected home capabilities, built-in WiFi allows you to control the unit remotely via the SmartHQ app.

features.text: LED Light Wall
This wine center has an LED light wall that spans the back panel, illuminating the interior so every item is easy to find
Magnum Bottle Storage
Chill up to eight 1.5 liter bottles of wine or prosecco without scratching the label or sacrificing space on the other shelves
Smart Technology

The beverage center has Built-In WiFi so you can control it from anywhere. Using the SmartHQ app, you can remotely change your temperature or dim the LED light wall. Plus, you'll get the latest connected home capabilities with new modes and updates
Flush Installation
With built-in, flush-to-cabinet installation, this wine center fits in perfectly with your home's overall design
Dual Zone Temperature Control
This wine center has two distinct zones that maintain any temperature between 41 and 61 degrees Fahrenheit, so you can keep both red and white wines at the perfect serving temperature
46-Bottle Capacity
Enjoy plenty of space to store rosé, champagne and all of your favorite wines
Articulating Door Hinges
These hinges prevent the wine center door from striking anything in the kitchen, including your cabinetry. They also help the door open smoothly and close softly
Open Door Notifications
Protect your bottle collection by receiving a push notification on your smart phone each time the wine center door is open
Adjustable Lighting

This wine center has flexible lighting options you can change from the SmartHQ app. Choose from proximity lighting that illuminates automatically as you approach, gradient lighting or lighting that turns on and off as you open or close the door
Temperature Alarm
With a WiFi connected wine center, you receive notifications when the door has been left open or the power goes out. Now you can maintain ideal temperatures even when you're on the go
